title: Simple Bouguer gravity map of the South Carolina Coastal Plain
citation: Madabhushi, Sriram, and Talwani, Pradeep, 2000, Simple Bouguer gravity map of the South Carolina Coastal Plain: South Carolina Geological Survey General Geologic Map Series GGMS-6, map scale 1:500,000.
notes: Single-sheet simple Bouguer gravity map (contour interval 1 mGal, colour scale -35 to 35 mGal) with a gravity-station inset and a study-area inset. The map shows no geologic units, structures, observations or geologic surfaces; gravity contours are geophysical, not a structure-contour or isopach map, and are not individually labelled (values only by colour ramp), so nothing fits the schema. No values recorded. Page was viewed as an image to confirm.
